items.hed: Houston answered a two-game skid by controlling Denver 110-100, with Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun combining for 43 points
items.insight: The Rockets led by double digits for most of Monday night at Toyota Center and improved to 8-3. Durant scored 23 and Sengun added 20 as Houston steadied itself after consecutive losses; the official team schedule carries the next matchup and broadcast details.

items.hed: Randy Flores reached the GM Meetings as Houston's new baseball operations chief with the manager search still open
items.insight: MLB's official preview lists Flores among the first-year baseball operations leaders attending the Las Vegas meetings. His first Astros offseason begins with a manager to hire and roster decisions to organize before the sport's Dec. 1 labor deadline.

items.hed: The Texans turn from Sunday's 44-22 win to a Week 10 road date with Cleveland at 1 p.m. Eastern
items.insight: Houston's official game page lists Sunday's matchup at Huntington Bank Field on FOX. The Texans enter after C.J. Stroud threw five touchdown passes against the Chargers and the defense forced two turnovers; the Browns game is the next test of whether that complete performance carries forward.
